verdict.rationale: Embedding a UI framework into an existing server-rendered page is a fair question for Svelte, but the evidence never documents mounting components into an existing non-Svelte HTML page. The pack covers only the compiler's DOM updates, scaffolding new projects with sv create, and SvelteKit SSG/SPA modes. The `sv add` command updates an existing Svelte project, not an arbitrary server-rendered page, so it is adjacent and earns no credit.
